content_sections.text: Weightage/merit evaluation out of 30 marks Evaluation and verification of original documents Essential qualification: 10 marks (% of marks divided by 10) Disability: 2, 4 or 6 marks for 40-59%, 60-79%, 80-100% Backward area, landless, non-employment, widow, single daughter/orphan, 6-month training: 1 mark each; BPL: 2 marks Experience up to 5 years in Govt./Semi Govt.: up to 2 marks (0.4 per year for Class-III) Total weightage 30 marks; evaluation schedule on website in second week of February 2027

content_sections.text: Use the prescribed application form only; it can also be downloaded after 16.11.2026 from https://hppwd.hp.gov.in/recruitment. Paste a latest passport size photograph on the form. Attach self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents and certificates. Super-scribe the envelope: Application for the post of (name of the post). Send by Registered Post or by hand to The Engineer-in-Chief, HPPWD, Nigam Vihar, Shimla-171002. Application must reach by 15.12.2026 (Non-Tribal Areas) or 26.12.2026 (Tribal Areas).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HPPWD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in HPPWD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 22 vacancies: 3 Junior Engineer (Civil), 2 Junior Engineer (Mech.), 2 Junior Draughtsman, 15 Junior Office Assistant (IT).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for HPPWD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed form attached to the advertisement (pages 8-10); also downloadable after 16.11.2026 from https://hppwd.hp.gov.in/recruitment) and send it to The Engineer-in-Chief, HPPWD, Nigam Vihar, Shimla-171002, by registered post or by hand, to reach by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 18 to 45 (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: Upper age 5 years as per para 11 of Department of Personnel, Govt. of HP letter dated 22nd June 2020.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Fixed monthly amount @ Rs. 23,500 for Junior Engineer (Civil), Fixed monthly amount @ Rs. 23,500 for Junior Engineer (Mech.), Fixed monthly amount @ Rs15,500 for Junior Draughtsman, Fixed monthly amount @ Rs. 12,500 for Junior Office Assistant (IT).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: JE (Civil): Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering (or AMIE enrolled on or before 31.05.2013); JE (Mech.): Degree/Diploma in Mechanical/Automobile/Production/Aeronautical or Marine Engineering; Junior Draughtsman: Matriculation plus two-year Draughtsmanship (Civil) certificate from ITI; JOA (IT): 10+2, or Matriculation with ITI IT/ITES certificate or three-year Computer diploma, plus typing 30 wpm English or 25 wpm Hindi. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be bonafide resident of Himachal Pradesh. Must be a Citizen of India. No gender bar. JOA (IT): typing 30 wpm English or 25 wpm Hindi; exemptions for visually impaired and certain differently abled persons.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons with less than 40 percent of the relevant disability. Applicants who are not bonafide residents of Himachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Weightage/merit evaluation out of 30 marks. Evaluation and verification of original documents. Essential qualification: 10 marks (% of marks divided by 10). Disability: 2, 4 or 6 marks for 40-59%, 60-79%, 80-100%.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts to be filled on Job Trainee Basis (Class-III). Vacancy to be filled immediately after selection. Visually impaired JOA (IT) selectees must complete basic computer training in three chances, failing which services shall be terminated.
